name: Claude Code
description: inference@1 agent provider claude-code over the Claude Agent SDK.

permissionMode.title: Permission mode
permissionMode.description: Claude Code's permission mode for new and resumed sessions. Valet's tool gate still sees every call.

utilityModel.title: Utility model
utilityModel.description: Model for small side jobs such as naming sessions; may end in an effort (claude-haiku-5-5-low). Empty turns them off.

minRateLimitNoticePercent.title: Usage warning threshold (%)
minRateLimitNoticePercent.description: Only warn about approaching a limit at or above this share. Hitting a limit always shows.

hideBuiltinTools.title: Hide built-in tools
hideBuiltinTools.description: Remove Claude Code's own tools (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Agent, ...) so only valet's tools are offered.

disableClaudeAiConnectors.title: Hide claude.ai connectors
disableClaudeAiConnectors.description: Hide your claude.ai account connectors (Gmail, GitHub, ...). Built-in tools are not affected.

strictMcpConfig.title: Only valet's MCP servers
strictMcpConfig.description: Ignore project .mcp.json, user settings and plugins, so valet's is the only MCP server.

deferValetTools.title: Defer valet's tools
deferValetTools.description: Load valet's tools through Claude Code's tool search instead of the prompt.

denyTools.title: Denied tools
denyTools.description: Built-in tools Claude Code may never use, e.g. Bash.

tools.title: Built-in tool set
tools.description: The built-in tools offered. Unset keeps Claude Code's defaults; empty removes them all.

toolAliases.title: Tool aliases
toolAliases.description: Run a built-in tool as another tool, e.g. Bash -> mcp__valet__exec.

appendSystemPrompt.title: Extra system prompt
appendSystemPrompt.description: Appended to Claude Code's system prompt for every session. Part of the cached prefix.

settingSources.title: Settings files to load
settingSources.description: Claude Code settings files (and CLAUDE.md) to load. None by default: valet supplies the persona.

promptCacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
promptCacheTtl.description: For the main conversation. Unset uses Anthropic's default.

idleCloseMs.title: Close idle sessions after (ms)
idleCloseMs.description: The next prompt resumes the session. 0 keeps them open.

mcpToolTimeoutMs.title: Valet tool timeout (ms)
mcpToolTimeoutMs.description: How long Claude Code waits on one of valet's tools.

pathToClaudeCodeExecutable.title: Claude Code executable
pathToClaudeCodeExecutable.description: Unset uses the one bundled with the Agent SDK.

models.title: Model list
models.description: Replaces the built-in list. Rename or hide models on the Models page instead.
